negative.content: For every food/meal KБЖУ (calorie/macro) estimate, always include the calculation breakdown: weight used (given or assumed, and why), and the base reference figure (kcal/100g or standard portion) used.
User (girlfriend, being coached on nutrition/fitness): female, 35 years old, height 174cm, weight 66kg.
Goal: lose body fat and reduce water retention/edema ("избавиться от жира и отёков"); reports feeling soft/watery with cellulite and puffy arms.
Training: gym 3x/week, plus daily walking ~5-7km (sometimes more), occasional surfing. Sleep 7-8 hours/night.
Reported eating 1500-1800 kcal/day (usually 1500-1600, rarely above 2000) for ~3 months with no fat loss progress and even some weight gain; regular menstrual cycle but low libido.

Working hypothesis (agreed with user): reported low-calorie days likely undercount true weekly intake because of uncounted "cheat" days (e.g. pizza, chips, beer) 1-2x/week that can add 2000-3500 kcal; doing 7-day fully honest tracking (including cheat days) to find real weekly average before deciding between reverse diet vs. other approaches.
Tracking is logged in nutrition_log.md and training_log.md; user sends food photos (sometimes with portion weights) and voice notes about workouts (exercises, weights, reps, energy level 1-10).
User drinks regular (3.2% fat) milk by default unless stated otherwise.

User also sends Apple Watch activity screenshots (Move/Exercise calories, steps); these are logged in a dedicated column in training_log.md alongside meals to cross-check against calorie intake. Watch is not always worn during strength training, so Move calories can under-count true energy expenditure on those days — account for this when estimating weekly energy balance.

2026-07-30 morning weigh-in (day 1 of 7-day tracking): 66.3kg, measured before using the bathroom. For comparability, future weigh-ins during this tracking period should note the same conditions (morning, pre-bathroom) since that affects the reading.

Recurring homemade dish 'фаршированный перец' (stuffed pepper), per user's correction: small pepper (smaller than a fist), ~3 tbsp pure lean ground beef (no oil), 1 tbsp cooked rice, no sauce/oil added. Use this recipe for future calorie estimates of this dish rather than assuming restaurant-style with oil/sauce.

Estimated TDEE for user ~1900-2000 kcal/day (BMR ~1410 + activity from Watch/steps). Days 1-3 of honest tracking (29-31.07.2026) totaled ~1825 / ~2026 / ~1944 kcal (avg ~1930) — close to maintenance, confirming she was not actually in the deep deficit (1500-1600 kcal) she believed.

User repeatedly describes her body as 'soft/watery,' cellulite-heavy, with arms she perceives as 'thick as legs' — but this self-description has consistently and significantly diverged from what's actually visible in the photos she's shared (which show normal tone, proportionate limbs, no notable excess fat or edema). (2) Right shoulder subluxates/unstable — no rotational or overhead shoulder movements; use neutral-grip/machine-fixed-path exercises, face pulls for shoulder stability work.
